framework_selection.reasoning: Paper fine-tunes Open-Sora, MVDIT, and Hunyuan — all PyTorch-native diffusion models. LoRA adaptation uses PEFT (HuggingFace). Mixed precision BF16 requires PyTorch >=2.0. No JAX/TF mentions anywhere. torch.fft.fftn is the natural FFT backend. PEFT library needed for Hunyuan LoRA.

tensor_flow_specs.name: PhysicsMotionLoss.forward — full pipeline
pseudocode: INPUT: x0_hat: [B, C=3, T, H, W]  float32
video_c: [B, T, H, W] = x0_hat[:, c, :, :, :]
Apply Hann window h[t] to v along T axis
spectrum: [T, H, W] complex = torch.fft.fftn(v, dim=(0,1,2))
Build omega_x, omega_y, omega_t grids from lowpass_cube shape
ring_E: [Nr, T_lp] = sum |polar|² over M axis
C_m: [Nr, M, T_lp] complex = angular DFT of polar over M axis
C_m_tilde: [Nr, M, T_lp] complex = temporal DFT of C_m over T_lp axis
omega_star: scalar = closed-form Ω* (Eq A.7, m≠0)
accumulate L_motion over batch and channels
OUTPUT: L_motion: scalar  (added to backbone denoising loss × weight=0.1)

tensor_flow_specs.name: RidgeWLS solver — TranslationalMotionLoss
pseudocode: M = A^T W A + lam * I_3         → [3, 3]
fallback: pseudo-inverse if M is ill-conditioned

tensor_flow_specs.name: MotionComplexityFilter — stratified evaluation
pseudocode: rubric: 'simple' if dominant motion ≈ single rigid transform (translate/rotate/scale); else 'complex'
Send prompt + rubric to LLM API (GPT or local model)

risk_assessment.component: LoRA rank and target modules for Hunyuan
risk_assessment.description: Paper does not specify LoRA rank, alpha, or exactly which linear layers are targeted. SIR confidence 0.65. Wrong rank significantly affects parameter count and convergence.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Design LoRAWrapper with fully configurable target_modules list and rank/alpha via config. Default to rank=16; provide ablation script to sweep {4,8,16,32}.

risk_assessment.description: Optimizer not named in paper (SIR confidence 0.65). AdamW assumed.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Make optimizer a config parameter with factory pattern. Mark in config YAML with # ASSUMED comment.

risk_assessment.description: Bilinear interpolation on irregular polar grid can introduce energy leakage εinterp. Paper bounds this theoretically but does not provide calibration data.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Implement synthetic validation: generate known SIM(2) motions, measure εinterp empirically, log in tests. Use precomputed LUT (PolarLUT class) for reproducibility.

risk_assessment.description: T given as range 12–16 (SIR confidence 0.72). Different T changes spectral resolution and window leakage εwin.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Default T=16. Add --window_size CLI flag. Include sensitivity test in ablation script.

risk_assessment.description: Whether stop-gradient is applied to softmax weights is unspecified (SIR confidence 0.70). This changes optimization dynamics.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Default to fully differentiable (no stop-grad). Add --stop_grad_weights bool flag. Include in ablation.

risk_assessment.description: The exact LLM prompt/rubric for simple vs complex split is not published. SIR confidence 0.70.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Design MotionComplexityFilter as abstract base class with LLM and rule-based subclasses. Provide simple keyword-matching fallback.

risk_assessment.description: VQA A/T, SD Score, Action Recognition, BLIP-BLEU all defer to EvalCrafter official implementation which requires separate installation.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Wrap EvalCrafter as optional subprocess dependency. Provide --skip_evalcrafter flag. Document installation in README.

risk_assessment.description: Flow baseline requires RAFT checkpoint download and torchvision optical flow integration.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Keep FlowConsistencyLoss in separate optional module. Gate behind --flow_baseline_enabled flag.

risk_assessment.description: Large dataset (~1M videos). Download time and storage (~multi-TB) may be prohibitive.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Provide data/download_openvid.sh script. Support subset mode for rapid local testing (--max_samples N).
